name: Sweden
convention: Swedish bank days: statutory röda dagar that can fall on weekdays, plus the bank-closed eves (Midsummer Eve, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve — 'bankfria aftnar', closed by convention though not statutory). Weekend-falling named holidays included, flagged in notes. Whit Monday was abolished in 2005 (replaced by National Day June 6) and is correctly absent. Midsummer Day (always Saturday) and other structurally-weekend holidays omitted, as in FI.
sources: https://www.riksbank.se/sv/press-och-publicerat/kalender/ (page confirmed to exist; date tables could not be extracted — treat as unconfirmed primary)

Midsummer Eve follows the same first-Friday-on-or-after-June-19 rule as Finland: 2025-06-20, 2026-06-19, 2027-06-25.
Unlike Finland, Dec 31 is a Swedish bank closure day; unlike Norway, so is Jan 6 (Epiphany).
